user.title: Connect a tank to TankTutor
user.description: Create a device key for the tank in TankTutor (tank page, "Device keys") and paste it here.

data_description.url: Where TankTutor's API lives, ending with /api.
data_description.key: Starts with ttk_. It is shown only once, when you create it.

reauth_confirm.title: TankTutor rejected the device key
reauth_confirm.description: The key was revoked or is no longer valid. Create a new one in TankTutor and paste it here.

error.invalid_url: The address must start with https:// (or http:// for a local test).
error.invalid_key: That does not look like a TankTutor device key (it starts with ttk_).

abort.already_configured: This device key is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new device key was saved.

init.title: Sensors to send to TankTutor
init.description: Only the sensors you choose here are sent: type, value, unit and time. Nothing else leaves Home Assistant. Leave a field empty to stop sending it.

data_description.salinity_unit: ppt, or SG for a specific gravity. It is never guessed from the value.
data_description.ammonia_basis: free = NH3 as a sensor measures it; total = a test kit (NH3 + NH4).

events.title: Events: leak, level and others
events.description: A sensor that is on or off. An active event is sent at once and TankTutor can email you. Untick an event to remove it, or add a new one below and submit; leave the new fields empty to finish.

data.new_invert: Active when the sensor is off

data_description.new_name: leak, level_low, level_high, or your own name (a-z, 0-9, _; at most 10 own names per tank).
data_description.new_invert: For floats that are closed when the level is fine.

error.salinity_unit_required: Choose the unit of the salinity sensor.
error.ammonia_basis_required: Say whether the ammonia value is free or total.
error.event_entity_required: Choose the sensor of the new event.
error.event_name_required: Give the new event a name.
error.invalid_event_name: Use only a-z, 0-9 and _, at most 40 characters.
error.event_name_in_use: This event name is already used on this tank.
error.event_entity_in_use: This sensor is already used by another event.
error.too_many_custom_events: A tank can have at most 10 events with their own names.
